wrapscan.why: This repo's whole prose corpus is written at ~110 columns, not the 85-column house width — 716 findings in docs/ measured 2026-07-30, across every file rather than concentrated in a few. So this is a style mismatch spanning the corpus, not a backlog of sloppy lines, and it grows with every entry appended at the local style. Advisory until the review decides which way it resolves: adopt 85 for new prose and glob the frozen records, or exempt this repo's prose from the house width outright.
